# changelog

```go
import "github.com/brpaz/draftsman/internal/changelog"
```

Package changelog maintains the CHANGELOG.md file release\-strategy: pr commits alongside a version bump — a deliberate, scoped exception to draftsman's "never write a changelog file" rule, which continues to hold for release\-strategy: draft \(see .scratch/pr\-release\-strategy/spec.md\).

## Constants

<a name="Heading"></a>Heading is the top\-level heading a managed CHANGELOG.md starts with.

```go
const Heading = "# CHANGELOG"
```

<a name="Prepend"></a>
## func [Prepend](<https://github.com/brpaz/draftsman/blob/main/internal/changelog/changelog.go#L19>)

```go
func Prepend(existing []byte, version, date, body string) []byte
```

Prepend returns existing \(a CHANGELOG.md's current content, or nil/empty if the file doesn't exist yet\) with a new entry for version inserted immediately below the top\-level Heading \(added if missing\), so the newest release always reads first.
